name: Meikko 1
source:
"When we were young we always played together. Those sisters who were 10 years younger than me called me "oniisan"... Now as I move into a new home, little by little, life with these girls is very eventful..."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ146438.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: “小时候，我们总是一起玩。那些比我小10岁的姐妹都叫我‘哥哥’……如今我搬进了新家，和这些女孩的生活也渐渐变得热闹起来……”[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ146438.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
